Move to the next location.desc: This action enables the uav to move from its current location to the next location if two locations are connected. For example, the uav can move from location_1 to location_2 if they are connected.
Move to the next location.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to move from [position1] to [position2] if [position1] and [position2] are [state1].

Check if the uav has reached the goal lo.desc: This action enables a uav to mark that it has reached the goal, if it is at the goal position. For example, if position_2 is the goal position and the uav is currently at position_2, it can perform this action to indicate that it has reached the goal.
Check if the uav has reached the goal lo.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to mark that it has [state1] if it is at [position1] and [position1] is [state2].
